tools.name: preview_font
tools.description: Details for one font: styles, scripts, metrics, missing glyphs for a sample text and a specimen URL. Free.

tools.name: get_family
tools.description: Use after search_fonts when the user may want more than one style, or to see how a foundry licenses its fonts. tools.name: quote_license
tools.description: Price a licence (USD and USDC) and return machine-readable licence terms. Free, nothing is reserved.

tools.name: buy_license
tools.description: Buy a font licence. Call without payment to get x402 payment requirements (USDC), then again with the signed payment. Returns the signed licence and a download link per style; web licences also list WOFF2, WOFF and the original file under downloads[].formats. Spends money: confirm price and licensee

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_fonts" appears informational but accepts parameters (script) that enable code/file/secret access.
